extraction: SPOQ (Spec, Plan, Outcome, Quality) journal tracking: each agent writes SPOQ entry per work unit. Spec = what to build/fix. Plan = how. Outcome = what happened (CER, logs). Quality = verdict (PASS/FAIL). Maps to our Engine: Spec = engine target CER per script. Plan = TDD steps. Outcome = measured CER on 18 langs. Quality = Verdict PASS/FAIL. Journal in unified-memory session scope. Enables Orchestrator audit trail.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether SPOQ journal mandated for Engine/Verdict/Miss per engine
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
